title: About the Program
intro: The RMCTC Culinary Arts program (CIP 12.0508) prepares high school career and technical education students for the culinary industry and further study. Students progress through Levels 1, 2 and 3 and operate the student-run restaurant, Bistro @ RMCTC, led by Chef John O'Connell.
philosophy: Professionalism is practiced, not simply discussed.
Mise en place applies to the kitchen, learning, and life.
Skills are developed through purposeful practice and feedback.
Understand both the how and the why of every technique.
how: Use the Home page every day for your bell ringer and challenge.
Open your level dashboard and work through the units.
Practice with knowledge checks. Retry until you can explain each answer.
Do official, graded work in Canvas using the Back to Canvas link.
limits: This is a static practice site. It cannot see your Canvas account, grades or submissions, and it cannot submit work or sync grades. Practice progress stays in your browser. Content labeled as demonstration has not yet been verified as official curriculum.
